questions.question: Find the factors of the expression 3x 2 - 16x + 5. व्यंजक 3x 2 - 16x + 5 के गुणनखंड ज्ञात करें
questions.solution:
3x2 - 16x + 5

= 3x2 - 15x - x + 5

= 3x (x - 5) - 1 (x - 5)

= (x - 5) (3x - 1)

Hence, required factors are (x - 5) and (3x - 1).
